reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getFillableCategories, keeps isFixedGroup/hasSavedTemplates, and routes the 3/6/12-month actions through the existing setNMonthAvg.

duplication.why: Removes the repeated select-filter-batch loop via fillCategories and a shared MonthWideArgs type; the hidden rule is still applied twice (getFillableCategories SQL and the pre-existing inline check in copyPreviousMonth).

placement.why: Selection and iteration helpers sit in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use them.

scope.why: Besides the flag, it restructures every month-wide action into fillCategories callbacks and swaps set3MonthAvg's inline averaging for setNMonthAvg, a refactor the request did not ask for.

maintainability.why: The resulting shape (one selection, one iteration helper, thin actions) is easier to own, though copyPreviousMonth remains a separate path with its own copy of the eligibility checks.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth keeps its pre-existing inline eligibility checks over getBudgetData, extended with the flag; the other actions all go through getFillableCategories/fillCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The hidden-category check in copyPreviousMonth is the existing parallel check, openly extended; the refactor removes rather than reshapes the per-action loops.
